newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: XEROX RETURNS TO S.AFRICA - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: XEROX RETURNS TO S.AFRICA - REPORT.

text.p: Copier group Xerox Corp has returned to South Africa after a 10-year absence due to anti-apartheid sanctions, the Johannesburg Sunday Times newspaper said on Sunday.
It said its British operation, Rank Xerox, had bought half of its former South African business, XeraTech, from Fintech, which was not available for immediate comment.
"Market sources value the deal at around 100 million rand ($22.37 million)," the paper said.
It said XeraTech, with annual sales of over 550 million rand, would now be called Xerox SA.
Bill Venter, chairman of Fintech's parent company Altron, told the Sunday Times that Xerox approached his group about the deal only a month ago.
Fintech paid about 40 million rand for Xerox's South African operations in 1987 when the U.S.-based multinational disinvested.
